sem colors

sem.color.bg.app{ref.color.mist-100}surface

Root/page background — the canvas every panel sits on. Root and page background, the base layer of every view. Do not: Cards or raised chrome — use bg.surface / bg.surface-raised so panels read as elevated.

sem.color.bg.surface{ref.color.white}surface

Panel, section, and default card surface — one step above the app canvas. Panels, sections, cards — the default working surface.

sem.color.bg.surface-raised{ref.color.white}surface

Raised chrome: tab strips, inputs, popovers, drawers. Inputs, popovers, drawers, and other chrome raised above the panel surface.

sem.color.bg.hover{ref.color.mist-150}interaction

Hover fill on rows, buttons, and list items — the only hover treatment (no shadow, scale, or glow). Hover background on any interactive row, button, or list item.

sem.color.bg.active{ref.color.mist-200}interaction

Pressed / active background. Pressed state background on interactive surfaces.

sem.color.bg.selected{ref.color.mist-250}interaction

Neutral selection background where the accent soft fill would be too strong. Neutral selected-row background in dense chrome. Do not: Primary selection — that pairs accent.soft with a left accent bar.

sem.color.text.primary{ref.color.slate-900}text

Primary content ink: titles, selected-row foreground, headings. Panel titles, primary content, selected-row foreground.

sem.color.text.default{ref.color.slate-700}text

Body text and default row labels. Body copy, row labels, field labels.

sem.color.text.muted{ref.color.slate-500}text

Secondary and supporting copy, meta text. Secondary copy, counts, meta rows, ghost-button labels.

sem.color.text.subtle{ref.color.slate-550}text

Tertiary ink: identifiers, de-emphasized meta. Identifiers, placeholders, tertiary meta. Do not: Actionable copy on its own — pair with primary text or an affordance.

sem.color.text.disabled{ref.color.slate-400}text

Disabled controls and empty-state copy. Disabled control labels, empty-state hints. Do not: Body copy — this step is below the AA body-contrast floor by design.

sem.color.text.on-accent{ref.color.white}text

Label ink on the accent fill. Flips by mode: white on the deep light-mode green, near-black on the brighter dark-mode green. Text and icons sitting on accent.primary fills (primary buttons).

sem.color.border.subtlergba(32, 36, 40, 0.10)border

Default panel/section divider hairline. Section dividers and quiet card edges — borders carry the structure, not shadows.

sem.color.border.defaultrgba(32, 36, 40, 0.20)border

Raised-surface divider, popover and input edge. Input borders, popover edges, clear hairlines.

sem.color.border.strongrgba(32, 36, 40, 0.30)border

Hover emphasis and structural separators. Hover-emphasized edges, structural separators, ghost-button borders.

sem.color.border.focusrgba(47, 106, 74, 0.55)border

Focus ring color on every focusable primitive (green family, tracks the accent). The 2px focus-visible ring on every focusable primitive. Do not: Resting borders or dividers — focus only.

sem.color.accent.primary{ref.color.green-700}accent

The single product accent — signature green. Selection and primary action share it. Primary CTA fill, active selection chrome, active-tab underline. Do not: Decoration, category coding, or a second accent hue anywhere in a view.

sem.color.accent.hover{ref.color.green-800}accent

Accent hover step: deepens on light, brightens on dark. Hover state of accent.primary fills.

sem.color.accent.softrgba(47, 106, 74, 0.10)accent

Soft accent fill for selected rows. Selected-row fill, paired with a 2px left bar of accent.primary.

sem.color.accent.soft-strongrgba(47, 106, 74, 0.18)accent

Stronger soft accent fill for selected-card emphasis. Selected-card border fill where soft is too faint.

sem.color.status.neutral{ref.color.gray-500}status

Idle / neutral status mark. Idle or unknown status dots and inline status copy. Do not: Button fills, chrome tints, or category coding — status only.

sem.color.status.good{ref.color.emerald-700}status

Done / ready / healthy. Kept apart from the forest accent by brightness and saturation. Completion and health marks: done discs, success dots. Do not: Anything decorative; never retune toward the accent green.

sem.color.status.warn{ref.color.amber-800}status

Warning / needs-input. Needs-input and warning marks. Do not: Button fills or chrome tints — status only.

sem.color.status.danger{ref.color.red-600}status

Error / blocked / failed; destructive-action fill. Error marks, failed states, destructive-button fills, invalid-field borders.

sem.color.status.merged{ref.color.violet-500}status

Merged-and-complete purple, constant across modes so 'merged' stays recognisable (GitHub-family semantic). Completed-and-merged marks, distinct from the plain green done.

sem.color.status.neutral-softrgba(100, 108, 120, 0.14)status

Soft neutral fill for banners and chips. Neutral banner and chip fills in inspectors and drawers. Do not: Default panel chrome.

sem.color.status.good-softrgba(21, 127, 55, 0.20)status

Soft success fill for banners and chips. Success banner and chip fills in inspectors and drawers. Do not: Default panel chrome.

sem.color.status.warn-softrgba(204, 132, 0, 0.20)status

Soft warning fill for banners and chips. Warning banner and chip fills in inspectors and drawers. Do not: Default panel chrome.

sem.color.status.danger-softrgba(220, 40, 40, 0.16)status

Soft error fill for banners and chips. Error banner and chip fills in inspectors and drawers. Do not: Default panel chrome.

sem.color.overlay.scrimrgba(20, 24, 28, 0.42)overlay

Modal/dialog backdrop above panel chrome. A plain translucent layer — never add backdrop-filter to a full-viewport scrim. The backdrop layer behind modals, dialogs, and drawers. Do not: Combining with backdrop-filter blur — full-viewport blur re-renders every frame and tanks pointer framerate.

Glyphs

Principles

Extracted from the Multicode app's documented design language (knowledge/brand/ and src/renderer/src/assets/index.css in the source product). These are the source's de-facto rules restated for this bundle; each is a proposal until confirmed in review.

One accent

  • One accent hue per view: the signature green (sem.color.accent.primary). Active selection and primary action share it; hover lifts to accent.hover.
  • Boxed selection is a 2px left bar of accent.primary over an accent.soft fill — never a full accent-filled row.
  • Status colors are not accents: never use sem.color.status.* as button backgrounds, section borders, chrome tints, or category coding.

Hairlines carry the structure

  • Borders do the structural work. Cards, badges, and shadows do not.
  • The only drop shadow is sem.shadow.drawer, on drawers and overlay panels.
  • Hover is a background change (sem.color.bg.hover) only — no shadow, no scale, no glow.

Coarse, deliberate scales

  • The surface ramp (bg.app → bg.selected) is intentionally coarse; do not invent intermediate steps or blue-shifted variants.
  • At most 2 border radii per view; radius.control (5px) is the default, larger radii belong to overlays and modal shells only.
  • At most 3 text sizes per view; the rhythm repeats title / body / meta.

Type

  • Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for identifiers, code, and kbd.
  • Sentence case everywhere except keyboard shortcuts. No uppercase-tracking chrome.
  • Tabular numerals on every numeric column; identifiers use mono at font.size.meta in text.subtle.

Status is earned

  • Status reads by shape first, color second — every state must survive grayscale. Done/healthy items render no mark by default.
  • Only genuinely live work animates (a single spinner or pulsing dot); nothing ambient.
  • The accent green (forest) and the success green (bright emerald) are kept apart by brightness and saturation; do not retune one toward the other.

Motion is rare and earned

  • One easing curve (motion.ease.standard), three durations. Hover/focus at fast, popovers at normal, drawers at deliberate.
  • Every animation honors prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
  • Never put backdrop-filter on a full-viewport scrim; separation comes from the scrim tone plus the drawer shadow.

Modes

  • Light and dark ship from the same semantic tokens; consumers style with --sem-* only and never write per-mode overrides.
  • Contrast floors are load-bearing: body text clears AA on its surface; text.subtle and text.disabled never carry actionable copy alone.
  • Dark-mode values keep the source's anti-dither discipline (solid channel values on multiples of 4, no pure black surfaces).

Tokens or nothing

  • Never hard-code a color. Every color resolves from a --sem-* variable; pick tokens by their documented role and use, not by their looks.

Components

Button

Light

Dark

Extracted from the source product's PrimaryButton, GhostButton, and IconButton primitives. One accent rule applies: a view has at most one primary button, and it shares its hue with selection chrome.

Anatomy

  • A single <button> element with the base class ds-button plus one variant modifier.
  • Optional leading icon sized by sem.icon.size.sm, gap 6px.
  • Label set in font.size.body at font.weight.medium, sentence case.

Variants

  • ds-button--primary — accent fill (accent.primary), text.on-accent label. The single primary action of a view.
  • ds-button--ghost — transparent, text.muted label; hover lifts to bg.hover + text.primary. Secondary and tertiary actions.
  • ds-button--icon — 24px square, borderless, icon-only. Must carry an aria-label. The canonical close affordance uses the close glyph.
  • Sizes: default sm (28px) and ds-button--md (32px).

States

  • Hover: primary deepens/brightens to accent.hover; ghost and icon gain bg.hover and stronger ink. No shadow, scale, or glow on hover.
  • Active: scale(0.97) press, removed under reduced motion.
  • Focus-visible: 2px ring of border.focus; never remove the ring without replacing it.
  • Disabled: 45% opacity, not-allowed cursor, hover suppressed.

Usage

  • One primary button per view; everything else is ghost or icon.
  • Destructive confirmation buttons swap the fill to status.danger — do not invent a third neutral-filled variant.
  • Keep labels to sentence case verbs ("Create workspace", not "CREATE").

Accessibility

  • Icon-only buttons require aria-label.
  • Focus is always visible via the border.focus ring.
  • The press animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
  • Contrast: label-on-fill clears AA in both modes (text.on-accent flips between white and near-black with the mode).
components/button/component.css
/* Button — extracted from the source product's PrimaryButton / GhostButton /
 * IconButton primitives (src/renderer/src/components/ui/Buttons.tsx). */

.ds-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-ui);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background-color var(--sem-motion-duration-fast) var(--sem-motion-ease-standard),
    color var(--sem-motion-duration-fast) var(--sem-motion-ease-standard),
    transform var(--sem-motion-duration-fast) var(--sem-motion-ease-standard);
}

.ds-button:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.ds-button:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sem-color-border-focus);
}

.ds-button:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.45;
}

/* Primary — the accent fill; selection and primary action share this hue. */
.ds-button--primary {
  background: var(--sem-color-accent-primary);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-on-accent);
}

.ds-button--primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--sem-color-accent-hover);
}

/* Ghost — quiet secondary action; hover lifts ink and background together. */
.ds-button--ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-text-muted);
}

.ds-button--ghost:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--sem-color-bg-hover);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-primary);
}

/* Sizes: sm (28px, default) and md (32px). */
.ds-button--md {
  height: 32px;
}

/* Icon — square, borderless; requires an accessible name on the button. */
.ds-button--icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--sem-color-text-muted);
}

.ds-button--icon:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--sem-color-bg-hover);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-primary);
}

.ds-button--icon svg {
  width: var(--sem-icon-size-sm);
  height: var(--sem-icon-size-sm);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ds-button {
    transition: none;
  }
  .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) {
    transform: none;
  }
}

Shown in the sidebar and the switcher.

That folder does not exist.

Shown in the sidebar and the switcher.

Extracted from the source product's Field wrapper (label + control + one supporting message) and its 28px raised input chrome.

Anatomy

  • ds-field — vertical stack, 6px gap: label, control, one supporting message.
  • ds-field-label — font.size.body at font.weight.medium in text.default; a required mark (*) in status.danger is aria-hidden and mirrored by aria-required on the control.
  • ds-input — 28px control on bg.surface-raised with a border.default hairline and radius.control.
  • ds-field-help / ds-field-error — font.size.meta; help in text.subtle, error in status.danger.

Variants

  • Default text input. The same chrome serves search inputs (add a leading search glyph) and other single-line controls.

States

  • Focus: border moves to accent.primary; keyboard focus adds the 2px border.focus ring.
  • Invalid: aria-invalid="true" moves the border to status.danger; the error message replaces the help text (never both).
  • Disabled: text.disabled ink, reduced opacity, not-allowed cursor.
  • Placeholder: text.subtle.

Usage

  • Exactly one supporting message at a time — help hides while an error shows.
  • Labels are sentence case, no trailing colon.
  • Do not stretch inputs beyond their content column; 28px height is the panel-chrome standard.

Accessibility

  • The label is a real <label for> pointing at the control.
  • aria-describedby points at the visible help or error message, whichever is shown.
  • Invalid state is conveyed by aria-invalid, not color alone (the error text names the problem).
components/input/component.css
/* Input — extracted from the source product's Field wrapper and the 28px
 * input chrome (src/renderer/src/components/ui/Field.tsx, InboxSearchInput.tsx). */

.ds-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-ui);
}

.ds-field-label {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-default);
}

.ds-field-required {
  margin-left: 4px;
  color: var(--sem-color-status-danger);
}

.ds-input {
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--sem-color-border-default);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  background: var(--sem-color-bg-surface-raised);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-default);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  transition: border-color var(--sem-motion-duration-fast) var(--sem-motion-ease-standard);
}

.ds-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--sem-color-text-subtle);
}

/* Focus signals with both the accent border and the ring, so it never reads
 * by color shift alone. */
.ds-input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--sem-color-accent-primary);
}

.ds-input:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sem-color-border-focus);
}

.ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-status-danger);
}

.ds-input:disabled {
  color: var(--sem-color-text-disabled);
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

/* One supporting message at a time: help hides when an error shows. */
.ds-field-help {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-meta);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-subtle);
}

.ds-field-error {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-meta);
  color: var(--sem-color-status-danger);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ds-input {
    transition: none;
  }
}

Task card

Light

Dark

Extracted from the source product's TaskCard primitive — the canonical board-card and inbox-row surface. Its family contract keeps every worklist in the product reading as one system.

Anatomy

  • The card itself is the single interactive element (a <button> or a row with one click target) on bg.surface with a border.subtle hairline and radius.control.
  • Leading: an optional 6px status dot (ds-task-card-dot). Status only — omit it when the surrounding column or text already states the status.
  • Identifier: mono, tabular numerals, font.size.meta, text.subtle.
  • Title: font.size.body at font.weight.medium, truncating to one line.
  • Trailing: display-only meta (age, count) in text.muted; never interactive.

Variants

  • Row (shown): one line, identifier and title share the baseline.
  • Card: identifier above the title, title clamps to two lines — same tokens, different stacking; rebuild per layout need.
  • Dot tones: default neutral, --good, --warn, --danger.

States

  • Hover: bg.hover only — no shadow, scale, or glow.
  • Selected: accent.soft fill plus a 2px left bar of accent.primary; title ink lifts to text.primary.
  • Focus-visible: 2px border.focus ring.

Usage

  • The dot is a status signal, not decoration or category color; done/healthy rows usually carry no mark at all.
  • Do not add a second interactive element inside the card; actions live in a context menu or the detail surface.
  • Keep the trailing slot to short meta (relative age, a count).

Accessibility

  • The card exposes one accessible name combining identifier and title.
  • Selection is conveyed with aria-pressed (or aria-selected in list semantics), not color alone — the left bar doubles as the non-color cue.
  • Status dots are aria-hidden when adjacent text already carries the state; otherwise give them a role="img" label.
components/task-card/component.css
/* Task card — extracted from the source product's TaskCard primitive
 * (src/renderer/src/components/ui/TaskCard.tsx), the canonical board-card /
 * inbox-row surface. Family contract: 6px status dot, mono identifier,
 * medium title, accent-soft + left-bar selection, background-only hover. */

.ds-task-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  background: var(--sem-color-bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--sem-color-border-subtle);
  border-left: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-ui);
  text-align: left;
  width: 100%;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color var(--sem-motion-duration-fast) var(--sem-motion-ease-standard);
}

/* Hover is a background change only — no shadow, no scale, no glow. */
.ds-task-card:hover {
  background: var(--sem-color-bg-hover);
}

.ds-task-card:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sem-color-border-focus);
}

/* Selection: accent-soft fill plus the 2px left accent bar. */
.ds-task-card--selected {
  background: var(--sem-color-accent-soft);
  border-left-color: var(--sem-color-accent-primary);
}

/* 6px status dot. Status only — never decoration or category coding. */
.ds-task-card-dot {
  flex: none;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--sem-color-status-neutral);
}

.ds-task-card-dot--good {
  background: var(--sem-color-status-good);
}

.ds-task-card-dot--warn {
  background: var(--sem-color-status-warn);
}

.ds-task-card-dot--danger {
  background: var(--sem-color-status-danger);
}

.ds-task-card-id {
  flex: none;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-meta);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-subtle);
}

.ds-task-card-title {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-default);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.ds-task-card--selected .ds-task-card-title {
  color: var(--sem-color-text-primary);
}

/* Display-only trailing slot (never interactive — the card is the target). */
.ds-task-card-trailing {
  flex: none;
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-meta);
  color: var(--sem-color-text-muted);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ds-task-card {
    transition: none;
  }
}
